title: Baa Juice Watermelon Mojito 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Baa Juice Nic Salt Watermelon Mojito combines the juicy sweetness of ripe Watermelon with the zesty tang of Lime and a cool Mint finish. This cocktail-inspired blend delivers a smooth and uplifting vape, perfect for fans of fruity flavours with a refreshing twist. Part of the Baa Juice Bar Salts collection, this nicotine salt e-liquid is crafted with a double-concentrated flavour profile to replicate the bold, intense taste of single-use disposable vape bars. With a 50VG/50PG ratio, it’s ideal for Mouth-To-Lung (MTL) pod kits and starter devices, providing smooth throat hits and rapid nicotine satisfaction. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, Watermelon Mojito offers a versatile and economical alternative to disposable vape devices.
